notes.title: Demo v2.0 Out
notes.content: Based on all of the feedback and bug testing, this new version of the demo is a much cleaner, and more complete version. I hope everyone enjoys their time

notes.title: [FIXED] Broken Build (And Oppressive Governments)
notes.content:
[NOTE: The build has been fixed and is now live.]

Hello, if you are trying to play the game, please wait until further notice because the current build is broken and the update is unable to be uploaded at the moment because of the oppressive government of my country banning SMS communications, which is required by Steam for updating games. 

This is very frustrating for me but unimportant in the grand scheme of things.

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Hey guys, from the first wave of feedbacks I fixed everything I immediately can. Mainly:

- Better map system, it now shows van and player icons in real time
- Better level design, some objectives were hard to find for people
- Better save system, it now saves after every time a new main mission is started
- Pause menu (believe it or not i didnt think anyone would care if the game had this lol)
- Options menu (mouse sensitivity)
- Other quality of life improvements
